title: Modern Cottage East Nashville
description:
Beautiful renovated cottage in the heart of booming East Nashville! The cottage is 400 sq ft of your own private space. This property is my home but the only thing shared is the driveway.  You'll have full privacy in your own space with your own entrance, bedroom, open living area/ Ikea kitchen, with everything you need including microwave, stove, and refrigerator.
There's a cozy electric fireplace, heated floors, and is a short walk (or drive) to local restaurants, shops and entertainment!

The space
The cottage is a wonderful space to comfortably accommodate 2 guests.  Everything is new! We consider this well established neighborhood to be the best!

Guests will have access to the cottage, fish pond and back deck area, and for more outside space can stroll down front 'neath the beautiful maple tree
for coopside ...'chicken tv'... Where Elliemay, Marygold, Fancy, Goldie & Ruby put on a show of their own! 

I am happy to answer questions about the area and reachable by text or phone most of the time, if not in person.

Experience all the great local flare of East Nashville shopping, restaurants, coffee shops, art, music and more. Ten minutes drive to lively downtown tourist attractions!

Guest parking is available. Walk to many local restaurants, coffee shops, Jenni's ice cream, & boutique shops. 'Lyft' or 'Uber' are also good options. Also, we are one block away from a public transportation/metro bus stop.

for some coopside ...'chicken tv'.
